workflow: Run precisely the enrolled ten visits on each role. The primary outcome is inherited retired user instructions for score_new, an unobserved ordinary Cargo invocation on separately primed targets after empty NEW and a real return to OLD. Neither test execution, the debugger, nor the file observer runs under the scored counter. Keep the discovery pair separate.
guards: Use six independent worker boots and fresh targets, balanced arm order, inherited physical matched source compilers, full unscheduled/offline/unit-graph controls, invalid source, failing then repaired native test, clean test executable, shifted GDB line and 168-case inventory. Require the original 63 codegen unit identities and complete independently clean objects in each edited candidate. Require exact P/C native binaries at each matching phase. Retain every score and failed block.
analysis: Use 1 - candidate/parent for each pair. Report medians and the exact 96.875% distribution-free sign interval [min,max] for the paired median. Report two-sided paired sign p and the one-sided balanced order-randomization p across all 20 assignments, using the mean paired log instruction ratio. Require six positive reductions, both p values at most 0.05 and minimum reduction at least 5% before treating this holdout as a repeatable win. Report cold resources, absolute instructions and byte costs separately.
